    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"])

    # Decision variables

        model.M, model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals
    )
    model.inventory = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals
    )
    model.backlog = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals
    )
    model.produce = pyo.Var(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary
    )
    model.startup = pyo.Var(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary
    )

            m.produce[mm, pp, tt] for mm in m.M for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        startup = d["startup_cost"] * sum(
            m.startup[mm, pp, tt] for mm in m.M for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        holding = sum(
            d["holding_cost"][pp] * m.inventory[pp, tt]
            for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        backlog = sum(
            d["backlog_cost"][pp] * m.backlog[pp, tt]
            for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        return setup + startup + holding + backlog

    # (a) Demand balance
    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prod = sum(m.production[mm, p, t] for mm in m.M)
        prev_inv = m.inventory[p, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        prev_back = m.backlog[p, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0

                == d["demand"][(p, t)] + m.inventory[p, t] - m.backlog[p, t])

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

        prod = sum(m.production[mm, pp, t] for pp in m.P)

    # (c) One product per machine per period

        return sum(m.produce[mm, pp, t] for pp in m.P) <= 1

    model.one_product = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=one_product_rule)

    # (d) Linking: production <= bigM * produce
    def link_rule(m, mm, pp, t):
        return m.production[mm, pp, t] <= d["bigM"] * m.produce[mm, pp, t]

    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=link_rule)

    # (e) Startup logic: startup >= produce - prev_produce
    def startup_rule(m, mm, pp, t):
        prev = m.produce[mm, pp, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0
        return m.startup[mm, pp, t] >= m.produce[mm, pp, t] - prev

    model.startup_logic = pyo.Constraint(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_rule
    )

    return model

    model.z = pyo.Var(model.M, model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.Binary)
    model.I = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))
    model.B = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, None))

    # ---------------- Objective (minimize) ----------------
    def obj_rule(m):

                      for p in m.P for t in m.T)

    def balance_rule(m, p, t):
        prev_t = t - 1
        prod = sum(m.x[mm, p, t] for mm in m.M)
        if prev_t in T:
            inv_prev = m.I[p, prev_t]
            back_prev = m.B[p, prev_t]
        else:
            inv_prev = 0
            back_prev = 0
        return prod + inv_prev - back_prev - m.I[p, t] + m.B[p, t] == d["demand"][(p, t)]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # ---------------- Machine capacity ----------------
    # sum_p x[m,p,t] + startup_time[m]*sum_p z[m,p,t] <= capacity[m]
    def cap_rule(m, mm, t):

        startup = d["startup_time"][mm] * sum(m.z[mm, p, t] for p in m.P)

    # sum_p y[m,p,t] <= 1
    def oneprod_rule(m, mm, t):

    model.oneprod = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=oneprod_rule)

    # x[m,p,t] <= bigM * y[m,p,t]
    def link_rule(m, mm, p, t):
        return m.x[mm, p, t] <= bigM * m.y[mm, p, t]

    model.link = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=link_rule)

    # z[m,p,t] >= y[m,p,t] - y[m,p,t-1]  (y[.,-1] = 0, forces first-period startup)
    def startup_lb_rule(m, mm, p, t):
        prev_t = t - 1
        if prev_t in T:
            y_prev = m.y[mm, p, prev_t]
        else:
            y_prev = 0
        return m.z[mm, p, t] >= m.y[mm, p, t] - y_prev

    model.startup_lb = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_lb_rule)

    # z[m,p,t] <= y[m,p,t]  (startup only when producing)
    def startup_ub_rule(m, mm, p, t):
        return m.z[mm, p, t] <= m.y[mm, p, t]

    model.startup_ub = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_ub_rule)

    return model
